notes: The official report of the Nebraska Board of State Canvassers (the canvass book), linked as 'General Election Official Results' from the Secretary of State's Previous Elections page: every contest the Board canvasses (federal, statewide and legislative offices, the State Board of Education, the Regents, judges' retention, community colleges, the Learning Community, natural resources, public power, utilities, reclamation districts, educational service units and the statewide questions), county by county, with each contest's Total row. The report's 'Reported Problems' page: Dawson County Dawson Public Power District – Dawson Subdivision is a “Vote for up to TWO” but it was erroneously listed as “Vote for ONE” on the ballot. This error was identified by Dawson County Clerk on October 7. At the time the error was identified, 240 ballots were already sent out to voters. The county clerk ordered corrected ballots on October 8 and mailed out corrected ballots on October 11 along with a letter of explanation to impacted voters to reduce the scope of the error. Of the 240 voters issued a corrected ballot, 239 returned or recast their ballot: 152 voters returned a corrected ballot, 26 indicated they only wanted to vote for one candidate and didn’t want to vote a corrected ballot, and 61 voters returned only the incorrect ballot without giving any indication that they didn’t want to vote the corrected ballot sent to them. One voter never returned either ballot. The difference in votes between second and third place was 20. Despite the outreach done by the clerk to reduce the scope of the error and corrected ballots being sent to all impacted voters, the 61 voters who only returned the incorrect ballot could have impacted the outcome of the election. Gage County After Election Day, it was discovered that Lower Big Blue NRD – Subdistrict 1 was left off the ballot in 32 out of 41 ballot styles. There were 2,396 voters who did not get to vote on this contest. There was only one candidate on the ballot and no write-in candidates. As a result, this error did not impact the outcome of the election. Johnson County On Election Day, it was discovered State Board of Education – District 2 was left off the ballot in one ballot style within one precinct. There were 54 voters who did not get to vote on this contest. The difference in votes between first and second place was 5,534. This error did not impact the outcome of the election.
